_comment: Invented households for the guest app's Money plan. Every number is made up; none is a rate, an award or a real person's pay. Values are what a person would type, as strings. tests/test_moneylife.py runs each through both engines.

examples.label: E-5 leaving an overseas post
examples.note: Married, one child, stationed in Germany with Overseas Housing Allowance, separating in 4 months with a job search under way. No VA claim decided yet.

examples.label: Medical retirement at 15 years
examples.note: Single E-6 retiring under Chapter 61 with a DoD rating of 50% and a VA award letter in hand. Retired pay entered after the VA waiver, as DFAS shows it.

examples.label: Guard member leaving drill status
examples.note: Married, two children, keeps a civilian job; drill pay stops. 3,200 retirement points so far.
